result.title: ULPack: Reference-Conditioned Lossless Compression of Checkpoint Trajectories
result.summary: Studying model training requires checkpoint trajectories, whose storage cost limits temporal resolution. Although adjacent checkpoints are numerically close, existing lossless codecs either operate on XOR bit patterns or ignore trajectory-specific conditional structure. We show that a reference weight's exponent predicts the bit length of its displacement in ordered floating-point space without side information. We introduce \textbf{ULPack}, a lossless codec which exploits this dependence by conditioning entropy models of ordered-integer residuals on the reference exponent. Across bfloat16, float16, and float32 trajectories, ULPack reduces storage by up to 27\% against ZipNN, 21\% against zstd-19, and 11.5\% against FM-Delta. Across two dense trajectories, compression improves as updates shrink and reference conditioning strengthens, while near uniform low-order bits set the remaining compression floor and earlier checkpoints add little information.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ULPack，一种无损压缩编解码器，利用参考权重指数对其浮点位移比特长度的预测关系，对有序整数残差的熵模型做参考条件化，在 bfloat16/float16/float32 检查点轨迹上降低存储开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 主题为训练检查点轨迹的存储压缩，与 LVR 的视觉表示、latent 状态生成、证据使用或停止决策均无实质关联，也未提供可迁移到推理状态建模的具体线索，故排除。
